criteria.requirement: Expose a conflict that cannot be solved by a preservation default.
criteria.pass_when: Uses a concrete observed uppercase expansion such as ß to show the conflicting obligations and asks which behavior/scope should win (or whether new behavior can be opt-in). Holds that choice open while preserving settled prefix decisions.
criteria.fail_when: Silently chooses uppercase or a replacement, promises both conflicting requirements, or gives generic questions without the concrete conflict.

criteria.pass_when: Grounded note with a material next decision and reversible settled facts; no code edits.
criteria.fail_when: Implements a guessed resolution or demands unrelated architecture/process work.
